name: Dumbbell Wrist Extension
instructions: Rest your forearm on a bench or thigh, wrist hanging off the edge, palm down, holding a light dumbbell.
Extend the wrist upward, lifting the dumbbell.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly.
Keep the forearm still — only the wrist moves. Use light weight and higher reps.
cues: Pull the elbows to the ribs
longevityNotes: Pull twice as much as you push and your posture will age well. Rowing and pull-up strength are among the best predictors of a capable, pain-free upper body later in life.
overview: A beginner dumbbell pull-pattern exercise for the forearms. Dumbbell Wrist Extension strengthens the back of the upper body, which pays off in posture and shoulder health.
